property_summary: After a successful sendMoney call, the recorded depositsCount of the contract must increase by exactly 1 if the low-level call recipient is address(this), otherwise remain unchanged; the bug always targets address(this), causing depositsCount to increment for every sendMoney call instead of only when the fallback is triggered by a direct ether transfer.
change_summary: Change the target of the low-level call from _target to address(this), altering where the ether is sent.
